items.textToSpeech: According to European Union regulations, the following food colours may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children:

sunset yellow, also known as E 110 or FD and C Yellow 6). quinoline yellow, also known as E 104. carmoisine, also known as E 122. allura red, also known as E 129 or FD and C Red 40. tartrazine, also known as E 102 or FD and C Yellow 5. and ponceau 4R also known as E 124.
